'''Tatrang VI''' was a [[Planetary ring/Legends|ringed]] [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]]&ndash;type [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with twenty-three [[Moon/Legends|moons]] that was located within the [[Tatrang system]],<ref name="PotG2" /> a part of the [[Tammuz sector/Legends|Tammuz sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It occupied the sixth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around the [[Star system/Legends|system's]] [[Star/Legends|star]], the [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]] [[Tatrang]]. The planet was considered to hold little economic value.<ref name="PotG2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tatrang VI was first mentioned in the [[1992]] sourcebook ''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Two]]'', which was written by [[John Terra]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="PotG2" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Tatrang system, and therefore Tatrang VI, in grid square U-14.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
